chain.label: Pilot did not obtain required preflight weather briefing
chain.trigger: No evidence exists to indicate that the pilot sought or obtained an updated weather briefing for the accident flight

chain.label: Rising, up-sloping terrain along the saddle route to Mauna Loa
chain.trigger: the airplane's altitude increased from about 6,600 to 9,600 feet ... the underlying terrain's elevation was about 4,600 feet msl [and] increasing

chain.label: Pilot elected to fly the VFR-only tour route into cloud, contrary to authorization
chain.trigger: the accident pilot performed a tour flight ... the airplane can be seen flying in clouds on several occasions and in different locations

caused_by.evidence: the pilot's failure to obtain a preflight weather briefing was a deviation from standard operating procedures

chain.label: Pilot flew into instrument meteorological conditions
chain.trigger: the Safety Board therefore concludes that on the accident flight, the pilot flew into instrument meteorological conditions (IMC)

caused_by.evidence: on September 4, 1999 ... the accident pilot performed a tour flight ... flying in clouds on several occasions

chain.label: Pilot failed to use available navigational aids to monitor ground track and altitude
chain.trigger: when he departed visual meteorological conditions and flew into IMC, he should have used the navigational aids to accurately monitor his ground track and altitude

caused_by.evidence: when he departed visual meteorological conditions and flew into IMC, he should have used the navigational aids

chain.label: Pilot did not reverse course or take emergency action as terrain clearance decreased
chain.trigger: During the last few minutes of flight, when the airplane's ground clearance was rapidly decreasing, the pilot did not reverse course or take emergency action

caused_by.evidence: If the pilot had been using his navigational aids correctly, he would have realized that he was nearing high terrain and would likely have changed his course

chain.label: Airplane closed with the rising terrain of the Mauna Loa slope
chain.trigger: Radar data indicates that at this point in flight, the airplane's track varied little from its predominately west-northwesterly direction

caused_by.evidence: the pilot did not reverse course or take emergency action
the underlying terrain's elevation was about 4,600 feet msl [and] increasing

chain.label: Airplane struck the northeast slope of Mauna Loa
chain.trigger: about 1726, the accident airplane crashed on the northeast slope of the Mauna Loa volcano at 10,100 feet msl

caused_by.evidence: the accident airplane crashed on the northeast slope of the Mauna Loa volcano

chain.label: Pilot and all nine passengers killed
chain.trigger: The pilot and all nine passengers on board were killed, and the airplane was destroyed by impact forces and a postimpact fire

caused_by.evidence: the airplane was destroyed by impact forces and a postimpact fire
